note: Turner County SD has no queryable zoning district service. The county's planning page links only a 2008 zoning ordinance PDF (which adopts the official zoning map by reference) and static JPG land use maps. The county's GIS pages (gismaps.org, turner.sdcounties.org) list no REST endpoint. The largest city, Parker, publishes its Zoning Map only as a static JPG. Centerville's ArcGIS Online zoning service is for Houston County, Texas, not South Dakota. ArcGIS searches for Turner County, Parker, and Centerville found no SD zoning layer. Hurley, Marion and Viborg publish only ordinance text, with no district layer found.
